opis: DINNER in the kitchen from the reference picture, evening light: the ROE DEER, the FOX and the SQUIRREL sit at the wooden table round one big steaming pot of pasta. The FOX slurps ONE very LONG strand of spaghetti that goes from his plate up to his mouth, his cheeks puffed, laughing; the little SQUIRREL holds up ONE tiny short elbow macaroni on her fork, delighted; the DEER laughs at them. Plates, forks, a bowl of grated cheese. Cosy and funny.
